title: 第九章 百倍悟性刷新小比前夜开悟第十章 一剑破盾废丹房新人入局
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
回到丙三十九号院，周荒立刻封门闭关。
合欢堂给了七日时限。
他没有半点浪费的资格。
双修夺根之法还剩五日，如今对他用处不大。可系统天赋暂时用不上，不代表他只能干等。
修为、术法、丹药、法器。
能多准备一分，擂台上就多一分活路。
周荒把储物袋里的东西全部倒出。
林语嫣的袋子最富。
灵石一百三十六块，几瓶合欢堂丹药，两件低阶法衣，还有一支红玉簪。
金钱子那边杂物更多，灵石四十九块，黑蛇鞭一条，账册副本，废丹房钥匙三枚。
真正让周荒心安的，是第一周留下的圆满级丹药。
聚气丹、升灵丹、驱毒散、回灵丹……
瓶瓶罐罐摆满半张桌子。
系统天赋会刷新。
可已经到手的东西不会消失。
这才是他敢接赌约的底气。
他吞下一枚升灵丹，运转青木炎诀。
火木双灵根一动，院中灵气像被漩涡牵引，源源不断钻入体内。
若说以前五行废灵根吸灵气像破碗接雨，漏得比接得多。
那现在就是拿桶往井里舀。

痛快。
但周荒没有被这种痛快冲昏头。
炼气六层刚破，丹药残力仍在经脉中翻涌。若一味猛冲，短期爽，日后筑基便可能留下隐患。
他用整整一夜稳固修为。
天亮时，青木炎诀入门，御风步勉强入门，焚木剑诀仍差些火候。
不够。
远远不够。
外门小比不是杂役斗殴。
他花两块灵石买了一份外门小比名册。
外门第一韩无极，炼气九层，银霜剑诀大成。
第二秦岳，炼气八层巅峰，掌心雷法霸道。
第三孟开山，金石体，肉身堪比法器。
前十里最弱的，也有炼气七层后段。
名册最后还附了一句坊市评语：
“新人周荒，疑似合欢堂弃鼎，赔率奇高，若能过首轮，可小押。”
周荒看得直乐。
合欢堂弃鼎？
好。
那他便让这些人看看，被弃掉的鼎，也能把整个外门砸出个响。
午后，他去了外门坊市。

他需要一件趁手兵器。
content_en:
Returning to Courtyard No. 39, Zhou Huang immediately closed the door and retreated.
Hehuan Tang gave a time limit of seven days.
He has no right to waste anything.
There are still five days left in the dual cultivation method of seizing roots, and it is of little use to him now. But just because the system talent was temporarily unavailable, it didn't mean that he could only wait.
Cultivation, spells, elixirs, magic weapons.
The more you can prepare, the more you can survive in the ring.
Zhou Huang poured out all the contents of the storage bag.
Lin Yuyan's bag is the richest.
One hundred and thirty-six pieces of spiritual stone, several bottles of Hehuantang elixir, two low-level robes, and a red jade hairpin.
There are more sundries on Qianzi's side, including forty-nine spiritual stones, a black snake whip, a copy of the account book, and three keys to the useless alchemy room.
What really made Zhou Huang feel at ease was the perfection-level elixir left in the first week.
Qi Gathering Pill, Spirit Ascension Pill, Poison Expelling Powder, Spirit Recovery Pill...
Bottles and cans filled half the table.
System talents will be refreshed.
But what you have already acquired will not disappear.
This was the reason why he dared to accept the bet.
He swallowed a spiritual elixir and activated the Aoki Flame Technique.
When the two spiritual roots of fire and wood moved, the spiritual energy in the courtyard seemed to be drawn by a whirlpool, and penetrated into the body continuously.
If we say that in the past, the Five Elements Wasted Spiritual Root absorbed spiritual energy like a broken bowl catching rain, it leaked more than it caught.
Now it's time to take a bucket and scoop it into the well.
happy.
But Zhou Huang was not carried away by this pleasure.
The sixth level of Qi refining has just been broken, but the remaining power of the elixir is still surging in the meridians. If you rush all the time, you will be happy in the short term, but you may leave hidden dangers in future foundation building.
He spent the whole night stabilizing his cultivation.
At dawn, the Green Wood Flame Technique was introduced, Yufeng Bu was barely able to do so, and the Burning Wood Sword Technique was still not quite ready.
not enough.
Not nearly enough.
The outside competition is not a handyman fight.
He spent two spiritual stones to buy a roster of outsiders.
Han Wuji, the number one in the outer sect, has attained the ninth level of Qi refining and has mastered the Silver Frost Sword Technique.
The second Qin Yue is at the peak of the eighth level of Qi refining, with domineering thunder magic in his palms.
The third Meng Kaishan has a body of metal and stone, and his physical body is comparable to a magical weapon.
The weakest among the top ten is also the second level of Qi Refining.
At the end of the roster, there is a comment from the city:
"Newcomer Zhou Huang is suspected of being abandoned by Hehuan Hall. The odds are extremely high. If he can pass the first round, he can make a small bet."
Zhou Huang was delighted to see it.
He Huan Tang abandoned the tripod?
good.
Then he showed these people that the abandoned tripod could also make a loud noise on the entire outer door.
In the afternoon, he went to Waimenfang City.
He needs a handy weapon.
